implied_completion: New visual resources must load through the actual candidate scenes, carry distributable provenance and remain usable without development-machine paths or installed fonts.

mandatory_objectives: Deliver one bounded Isha opening-presentation increment anchored to PRD 2.3, 6.3, 6.4 and 6.10 and the active R04-owned dialogue finding.

Treat the pinned connected-slice evidence issue through a new reachability diagnosis and candidate-owned measurement repair; retain missing gameplay and unavailable Host evidence as unresolved.
Preserve the authored village, complete unarmed Ranger, working animation bindings, Q01 reward integrity, input suppression and nested pause/save recovery.
task_specification.objective: Finish the existing ordinary Isha opening conversation's portraits, reading surface and clothed idle actor while preserving its verified behavior and exposing the actual boundary of the still-incomplete connected slice.

diagnosis.root_cause: Three bounded cause clusters affect this module. First, the dialogue has functioning text and choices but absent portrait resources and insufficient illustrated framing. Second, Isha's adapter reconstructs rigid dress skin weights and applies lowered-arm poses; prior ordinary and diagnostic views demonstrate garment separation, making skin/rest compatibility a concrete suspect rather than a placement problem. Third, the connected-slice recipe reaches opening conversation and saving but lacks established ordinary acquisition/training and recovery routes. The inspected wrapper instantiates Isha and directs the player toward Hers without establishing the subsequent product integration. Missing gameplay and missing measurement must be distinguished. The settings surface also remains visually unfinished despite working pause and rebinding.

stop_conditions: Stop implementation expansion after the two selected observable conditions and their necessary dependency repairs; do not add later combat, training, chapters or a full settings rewrite.
If portrait or actor resources cannot be qualified through authorized sources, report the exact unavailable dependency and failed comparison. Keep the visual condition unmet.
